description: Look at a picture by its public URL: the server downloads it and returns it as an image you can see (about 1000 px). You cannot open URLs yourself, so use this before putting any photo into a template: check it really shows what the post says, has no watermark or other brand's logo, and survives the template's crop (portrait feed 4:5, story 9:16). http(s) only; private, local and non-image addresses are refused with the reason. Read only.

url.description: The picture's public http(s) URL (for example image_url from viralhunt_search_images).

name: viralhunt_fetch_image
